truths.truth: A freshly built, freshly spawned terminus mcp over a store with archived sessions answers one recall_search tools/call with real hits and exits 0 at EOF.
truths.evidence: cargo build -p terminus recompiled terminus v0.1.1. A scratch store was built by rooting tests/fixtures/session-recall.jsonl ({{ROOT}} replaced, 0 tokens left) and running target/debug/terminus ingest with TERMINUS_DATA_DIR, TERMINUS_CONFIG_DIR and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR under the scratchpad (exit 0, terminus.db created). Standing in root/project-alpha, one line {tools/call recall_search, query src/worker/S.ts} piped to target/debug/terminus mcp gave exit 0, one response line, isError false, resultType complete, hits 1 (turn_id 1, project root/project-alpha, reason null), and nothing on stderr.

truths.truth: server/discover answers the D-04 object, the same with _meta naming 2026-07-28 and with no params.
truths.evidence: With empty scratch dirs, id 1 (server/discover, _meta 2026-07-28) and id 2 (server/discover, no params) both returned exactly {_meta:{io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo:{name:terminus,version:0.1.1}},cacheScope:private,capabilities:{tools:{}},resultType:complete,supportedVersions:[2026-07-28],ttlMs:0}, identical lines and no instructions key. 0.1.1 is the workspace version (Cargo.toml:6, crates/terminus/Cargo.toml:4 version.workspace). Code: route arm mod.rs:189, discover() mod.rs:236-243, envelope from rpc::result rpc.rs:165-174. The unit test cmd::mcp::tests::server_discover_answers_the_one_stateless_revision_with_or_without_meta compares the whole object and passed in the suite run.

truths.truth: Every result (initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call, server/discover) carries resultType complete and the serverInfo _meta, added in one place, and tools/list carries ttlMs 0, cacheScope private and the three tools in fixed order with or without _meta.
truths.evidence: Wired in one place: rpc::result (rpc.rs:165-174) inserts resultType and _meta into every object result, and every result arm of route (mod.rs:186-216) goes through it. Observed on the binary: initialize for each of four revisions has keys [_meta, capabilities, protocolVersion, resultType, serverInfo]; ping, with and without 2026-07-28 _meta, has exactly [_meta, resultType]; tools/list with _meta (id 5) and without (id 9) carries ttlMs 0, cacheScope private and tools recall_search, recall_context, recall_get in that order; tools/call (id 4) carries content, isError, resultType and _meta; server/discover as in truth 2. The unit test every_result_carries_the_result_type_and_the_servers_identity_on_both_eras walks all five methods on both eras and passed.

truths.truth: server/discover, tools/list and tools/call whose _meta names a version other than 2026-07-28 are refused with -32022, data.supported [2026-07-28] and data.requested echoing the asked value, before the method runs.
truths.evidence: answer (mod.rs:170-179) calls unsupported(params) (mod.rs:224-227) on every request except initialize, before route. Observed: id 3 tools/list _meta 2025-11-25 gave error code -32022, data {requested:2025-11-25, supported:[2026-07-28]}; id 7 server/discover _meta 2025-06-18 gave -32022 with requested 2025-06-18; id 8 tools/call _meta 2024-11-05 gave -32022 with requested 2024-11-05. None of the three carried result. Code constant rpc.rs:57 and builder failure_with_data rpc.rs:188-194. The unit tests a_request_naming_another_revision_is_refused_with_what_is_supported (three methods by three asked values, a number included) and the_version_check_runs_first_and_never_on_initialize passed.

truths.truth: initialize is unchanged per D-08, which supersedes roadmap criterion 3: asking 2026-07-28 is answered 2025-06-18, the four legacy revisions are echoed, 2026-07-28 is not in PROTOCOL_VERSIONS, and a tools/list with no _meta and no prior initialize returns the tool list.
truths.evidence: PROTOCOL_VERSIONS at mod.rs:74 is [2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2024-11-05, 2024-10-07]. Its doc comment at mod.rs:65-67 says 2026-07-28 has no initialize and is offered through server/discover, and grep 'left out until' on mod.rs prints nothing. Observed: initialize asking 2026-07-28 (id 6) answered protocolVersion 2025-06-18 and still carried capabilities.tools and top-level serverInfo; initialize for each of the four legacy revisions echoed it. A process whose first line was a bare tools/list answered the three tools in order with ttlMs 0 and cacheScope private, exit 0. The unit tests initialize_negotiates_a_version_both_sides_know (pins !PROTOCOL_VERSIONS.contains(2026-07-28) by name) and a_tools_list_with_no_meta_and_no_initialize_is_served passed.

truths.truth: A spawned terminus mcp over a fixture store, fed server/discover, tools/list and one tools/call per tool, each on 2026-07-28 _meta with no initialize, answers every request with a result and exits 0 at EOF.
truths.evidence: Spawned target/debug/terminus mcp standing in the scratch store's root/project-alpha and fed five lines (server/discover, tools/list, recall_search query src/worker/S.ts, recall_context turn_id 1, recall_get turn_ids [1]), each with _meta io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion 2026-07-28 and no initialize or notifications/initialized anywhere. Exit 0 and 0 bytes on stderr. Five results with ids 1 to 5 in order and no error. discover is the D-04 object; the list has the three tools in order with ttlMs 0 and cacheScope private; search has 1 hit; context has 6 turns with anchor turn_id 1; get has 1 record holding turn_id 1 and 0 absent. The integration test a_stateless_conversation_with_no_initialize_answers_every_request (tests/mcp.rs, added in d186b22) passed, and the mcp test binary reported 28 passed.
